0022600009.text: The Spurs (0-1, on a one-game losing streak) are 4th in the Southwest, 1 game back, and 13th in the West, and they host the Rockets (1-0, on a one-game winning streak), who lead the Southwest and the West, in the second game of the 2026-27 season. Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and is a game-time decision for San Antonio, and Jayden Quaintance is out after knee surgery, while Houston is without Steven Adams, who is out with calf soreness. The teams have not met yet this season, and San Antonio won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 145-120 home win over Houston on March 8, 2026.
